Pre-Qualification Requirement (PQR) Pre-Qualification Requirement PQR-A: The bidder should be a manufacturer or an authorized dealer or a supplier of manufacturer for t he Solar LED Street Light/Solar LED Light. AND PQR-B: The bidder should have successfully executed/completed any Solar LED Street Light/Solar LED L ight Supply & installation work to any Government or Quasi-Government or Public Sector Undertaking o r Public Limited Company during the last seven years as on the original scheduled date of tender openin g for a minimum value of Rs. 10,69, 965/-, in a single purchase order in the name of bidder. Documentary proof in support of PQR A: For Manufacturer: Copy of the certificate showing the indented item manufactured & valid on the original scheduled date o f tender opening, issued by any of the following agencies and duly attested by Gazetted Officer/Notary P ublic towards proof of manufacturer shall be furnished. i. Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). ii. National Small Industries Corporation Limited (NSIC). iii. Small Scale Industries Ltd. (SSI) iv. District Industries Centres (DIC) v. Government or any accredited agency for International Organization for Standardization (ISO) For Authorized Dealer / Distributor / Supplier: i. A valid attested copy of dealership certificate issued by principal/manufacturer, for appointing as Auth orized Dealer / Distributor to supply of Solar LED Street Light/Solar LED Light. OR Tender specific authorisation letter from the concerned manufacturer to participate in the bid. ii. An undertaking from the Manufacturer stating that in the event, for any reasons, the dealership / dist ributorship gets terminated, the Manufacturer shall execute the contract with the Purchaser by manufac turer or any designated dealer/distributor, as though, it is his own and in all such cases provide directly to the Purchaser, financial and technical guarantee as prescribed in the tender specifications. Documentary proof in support of PQR B: Copy(s) of complete set of purchase order (PO) with material description & technical specification etc. al ong with material acceptance certificate or completion certificate or inspection cum receiving report (IR R). Note: If the bidder is the previous supplier of Solar Street Light/Solar Light satisfying PQR condi tions above to NLCIL, it is sufficient for the bidders to mention NLCIL PO /work order and IRR ref erence. The bidder shall be qualified based on their past performance with NLCIL.
